paper_metadata.title: Generative Multimodal Models are In-Context Learners
paper_metadata.abstract: The human ability to easily solve multimodal tasks in context (i.e., with only a few demonstrations or simple instructions), is what current multimodal systems have largely struggled to imitate. In this work, we demonstrate that the task-agnostic in-context learning capabilities of large multimodal models can be significantly enhanced by effective scaling-up. We introduce Emu2, a generative multimodal model with 37 billion parameters, trained on large-scale multimodal sequences with a unified autoregressive objective. Emu2 exhibits strong multimodal in-context learning abilities, even emerging to solve tasks that require on-the-fly reasoning, such as visual prompting and object-grounded generation. The model sets a new record on multiple multimodal understanding tasks in few-shot settings. When instruction-tuned to follow specific instructions, Emu2 further achieves new state-of-the-art on challenging tasks such as question answering benchmarks for large multimodal models and open-ended subject-driven generation. These achievements demonstrate that Emu2 can serve as a base model and general-purpose interface for a wide range of multimodal tasks. Code and models are publicly available to facilitate future research.

extraction_data.organization: Beijing Academy Of Artificial Intelligence, Tsinghua University, Peking University
extraction_data.innovation: In-context learning: Enables the model to quickly adapt to new tasks or environments with limited data by conditioning on task demonstrations, differing from prior supervised fine-tuning approaches that require extensive task-specific training data; Interleaved image/video-text data structure: Uses special tokens ([IMG], [/IMG], [VIDEO]) to embed visual frames into the autoregressive sequence, allowing the model to process mixed modalities natively; Grounded image-text pairs: Incorporates bounding box coordinates with text phrases to teach spatial understanding and grounding capabilities.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: LAION-2B, CapsFusion-120M, WebVid-10M, Multimodal-C4 (MMC4), YT-Storyboard-1B, GRIT-20M, CapsFusion-grounded-100M, Pile
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Instruction tuning for multimodal chat and academic tasks
extraction_data.extension: Simpler framework connecting Visual Encoder and Multimodal Modeling through mean pooling each image to 8x8 image patches, followed by restarting at a higher 448-pixel resolution.
extraction_data.research_problem: Multimodal in-context learning and general-purpose multimodal understanding/generation
extraction_data.application: Visual question answering, object grounding, visual prompting, object-grounded generation, instruction following, conversational AI, subject-driven generation
extraction_data.paper_title: Generative Multimodal Models are In-Context Learners
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Conversational data, COCO Caption, TextCaps, VQAv2, OKVQA, GQA, TextVQA, M3IT, RefCOCO, RefCOCOg, LLaVA, LLaVaR, ShareGPT, Alpaca, VideoChat, analog clock reading dataset
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on large-scale multimodal sequences with unified autoregressive objective -> Instruction tuning with conversational data
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Unified autoregressive framework handling interleaved text-image-video at both input and output
extraction_data.base_model: SDXL-base (for Visual Decoder), Stable Diffusion 2.1 (for Video Decoder)
extraction_data.benchmark_result: VQAv2: 68.8; OKVQA: 57.1; VizWiz: 57.0; TextVQA: 50.3; Hateful Memes: 66.0; State-of-the-art results on visual question-answering tasks; MM-Vet: 48.5
